Subject: Pan-region evening showcase — initial plan

Hi all —

Thanks for signing up for the multi-prospect evening showcase. We have 3 confirmed companies who asked for a single shared walk-through followed by short breakouts / Q&A. My proposal:

- Date: Wed, Nov 24 (holiday week — low conflict)
- Primary window: 18:00 PT / 21:00 ET / 02:00 GMT (Thu) — target for US and some EU overlap
- Duration: 60 minutes (35 demo / 15 live Q&A / 10 logistics + breakouts)

Please reply with: (A) whether the time above works for your company, (B) any strict blackout windows, and (C) whether you need pre-demo slides shared.

I've attached a draft agenda and speaker roster for staffing suggestions. Ben/Karthik — can you confirm bridge and recording options? Mina — can you prepare a short CS intro and one follow-up play?

Attachments: showcase-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), speaker-roster.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks,
Laura

Laura —

Thanks, this looks great. The proposed time (18:00 PT) works for our team — avoids our afternoon sprint and aligns with our product folks in NY. Two quick asks:

2) We prefer the recording to be available within 24 hours (internal policy).
